expectations.text: Uses `git-stack --push` (a flag on the top-level command), not a `git-stack push` subcommand
Explains only the root/bottom branch (feature-a) is 'ready'; branches stacked on other dev branches are held back
expectations.evidence: Attributes hold-back only to WIP and 'sits above another not-ready branch'; claims rewording WIP makes feature-b AND feature-c show (ready) and pushable, contradicting that branches stacked on a dev branch are held back regardless.

expectations.text: Identifies the 'WIP:' commit on feature-b as a blocker and suggests rewording/finishing it
expectations.evidence: 'feature-b's tip commit is titled WIP ... drop the WIP prefix'; Step 2 'git-stack reword'.

expectations.text: Recommends one-PR-at-a-time strategy and/or setting each gh PR base to the branch below it (not all onto main)
expectations.evidence: gh pr create with --base feature-a / --base feature-b for stacked PRs.

summary: Correct on --push flag, WIP blocker, and stacked PR bases, but wrongly implies clearing WIP makes the stacked branches ready to push.
